gates.name: Lumenia.CssArtworkAndCharacterIsolationGate

gates.name: Lumenia.CssSolidArtworkDrawingGate

gates.name: Lumenia.CosmicExhibitionIsolationGate
gates.measurement: The Next.js client graph limits Three.js to registered exhibition modules and excludes physics. The separate cosmos/interactive page admits source-identical registered scripts and optional Rapier after user activation; its manifest starts with physics disabled. Only digest-registered reference pictures are admitted. Existing CSS artwork and character checks remain enforced.
